title: Coin-operated turnstile
goal: Show the complete two-state turnstile machine with labelled coin and push transitions.

rubric.must: Exactly two operational states, Locked and Unlocked, are visibly shown.
A transition labelled coin visibly goes from Locked to Unlocked.
A transition labelled push visibly goes from Unlocked to Locked.
Locked has a visible push self-transition and Unlocked has a visible coin self-transition.
The initial marker visibly enters Locked.
